Sample Leave Law No. (1) of 2024

We, the drafting committee, have issued this sample law for testing.

Chapter One

General Provisions

Article (1)

Definitions

In this Law, "Worker" means any natural person employed under a contract, and "Employer" means any person who employs a Worker.

Article (2)

Scope

This Law applies to all private-sector employers and workers, except domestic workers who are governed by Article (5) of this Law.

Chapter Two

Leaves

Article (3)

Annual Leave

The Worker is entitled to annual leave of thirty days with full pay for each year of service.

Article (4)

Sick Leave

The Worker is entitled to sick leave of up to ninety days per year, the first fifteen days with full pay.

Article (5)

Maternity Leave

A female Worker is entitled to maternity leave of sixty days, of which forty-five days are with full pay.

Article (6)

Penalties

An Employer who violates Article (3) of this Law shall be fined no less than five thousand dirhams.
